title: Experience Model v6: bounded CompilerGym lifetime mechanism protocol
summary: Propose the exact v6 architecture for a conditional, unmodified official CompilerGym 0.2.5/LLVM/POJ104 mechanism program. There are exactly two primary on-policy agents: HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL. They share the same one-model ORIENT-to-THINK_ACT loop, canonical bounded context packet, ledger, bounded notebook/retriever, tools, task order, clock, SLEEP cadence, and reset policy. EXPERIENTIAL alone mounts one null-initialized, life-local LoRA rebuilt from its sealed public acquisition history; HARNESS performs the same deterministic SLEEP work but quarantines a sham adapter. Adapter-off and binding-shuffled checkpoints are sterile forks, not additional on-policy agents. This proposal authorizes neither package acquisition/install nor execution, training, compute, or a scientific claim.
system_thesis: A bounded context packet is the recurrent agent's explicit working state. If one frozen model repeatedly chooses focus and bounded common recall, acts against public LLVM feedback, and a deterministic compiler converts only outcome-grounded public transitions into the sole life-local learned inference object, later objective held-out action may improve under full-harness parity. The first test is a bounded causal mechanism assay, not an endpoint about private thought, consciousness, general intelligence, lifetime growth, or superiority to all external-memory agents.

nodes.before: No v6 CompilerGym context-state node exists.
nodes.after: Every ORIENT and THINK_ACT call reconstructs a capped canonical packet from immutable ANCHOR; harness-owned CLOCK_BUDGET; opaque LIFE progress; bounded FOCUS; public environment and legal actions; fixed-cap common ledger/notebook retrieval; complete-event recent-tail suffix; and response contract. ORIENT runs before every THINK_ACT, may return KEEP/zero queries, and is the same pinned model/bootstrap/tokenizer/sampling family and treatment LoRA as THINK_ACT. No learned scheduler, critic, router, retriever, hidden chat, prefix/KV, or unparsed scratch state exists.
nodes.rationale: Makes context the auditable conscious state and removes unobservable causal pathways.

nodes.before: The prior v1 control and fork source/lifecycle were under-specified.
nodes.after: HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL are the only primary on-policy agents. Both have identical base/bootstrap, packets, calls, public ledger, capped append-only notebook, target-blind common retriever, tools, task-local workspace, task order, caps, clock, and deterministic sleep schedule. EXPERIENTIAL alone atomically mounts one life-local LoRA; HARNESS performs a matched sham write whose bytes remain model-invisible quarantine. ADAPTER_OFF and BINDING_SHUFFLED are read-only sterile checkpoint forks from the experiential acquisition prefix, never agents collecting a third or fourth life.
nodes.rationale: Separates the on-policy whole-organism estimand from checkpoint necessity and outcome-binding interventions.

nodes.before: v1 did not fix the writer's row authority, target masks, credit rule, or optimizer lifecycle.
nodes.after: At fixed task-boundary sleeps, a model-free deterministic compiler consumes only a sealed life ledger prefix. It forms ORIENT, ACT, and REVISE rows from public state and public official outcomes using frozen epsilon, gamma=0.7, rho=0.5, target-blind candidate IDs/strata, exact dedup, 192-row/64-per-view cap, fixed 50:50 old/new replay, frozen ordering/truncation, and a loss mask of one only on typed focus or operation targets. Hypotheses/rationales are input or provenance only and never targets. It cumulatively rebuilds rank-16 alpha-16 q_proj/v_proj LoRA from clean pinned base with reset AdamW optimizer, 24 target-token touches/retained row, fixed anchor preservation rows, atomic receipt, and destruction of trainer state.
nodes.rationale: Identifies the learning objective without promoting self-authored thought to truth or leaving optimizer moments as a second life state.

nodes.before: No CompilerGym/POJ104 adoption contract exists in this v2 proposal.
nodes.after: Official CompilerGym 0.2.5 with LLVM 10, official IrInstructionCount/normalized-baseline reward, and official POJ104-v1 are candidate substrate bytes only. Adoption is conditional on a no-network, no-patch static/local-artifact and later separately authorized disposable offline install/semantic fit gate. The source/wheel, LLVM/runtime/dependencies, official factory/projection/reward semantics, and catalog must be hashable and unchanged. POJ104 must yield a sealed public-static, related-but-nonduplicate split excluding exact source/IR and near normalized CFG/callgraph/opcode/type/loop-shape neighbors; otherwise this change rejects the substrate rather than repairing, downloading, or substituting it.
nodes.rationale: Closes v1's benchmark, timing, relation, and upstream-mutation ambiguity without assuming that a 2026 archived dependency runs.

nodes.before: v1 mixed wiring, pilot, replication, and broader lifetime claims.
nodes.after: Stage A is CPU/static design and fit only. Stage B is a bounded non-claim hardware/model canary. Stage C is exactly one paired on-policy life: 8 acquisition programs, sleeps after 4 and 8, 4 sealed related/nonduplicate targets at checkpoints 0/4/8, six ORIENT/THINK_ACT decisions per program/target, adapter-off at every checkpoint, and final binding-shuffled fork. Stage D is later separately ratified fresh-task replication: at least three paired lives for a directional scout, then a powered post-context confirmation with broader controls and life-level slope analysis.
nodes.rationale: Preserves a small falsifier while preventing a one-life pilot from masquerading as a long-life or paper result.

edges.before: No explicit v6 packet transition exists.
edges.after: Authoritative state -> ORIENT ContextPlan -> identical bounded ledger/notebook retriever -> THINK_ACT one typed operation -> official public result -> sealed event and harness clock update. ORIENT cannot act and THINK_ACT cannot bypass the packet.
edges.rationale: Defines the graph-level conscious-state and retrieval transition under parity.

edges.before: No exact public outcome-to-write edge exists.
edges.after: Only complete sealed public acquisition records, including official result and resource receipt, enter deterministic credit/row compilation. The authentic manifest writes the treatment LoRA; HARNESS receives only the same non-visible sham write receipt.
edges.rationale: Prevents private thought, hidden evaluator information, evaluation descendants, and non-LoRA state from becoming learned experience.

edges.before: Fork conditions and their sources were ambiguous in v1.
edges.after: A sealed experiential checkpoint cold-loads authentic, adapter-off, and final binding-shuffled adapters into separate allowlisted evaluation processes. Each receives only its target packet, assigned adapter or null, and the shared bounded evaluation budget; all feedback/artifacts are quarantined and cannot return to life or SLEEP.
edges.rationale: Separates authentic on-policy history from causal memory intervention evidence.

edges.before: Benchmark feasibility was left to implementation after ratification.
edges.after: Stage B/C cannot begin unless immutable local-artifact/static fit, separately authorized offline semantic canary, sealed split, lifecycle/visibility tests, independent review, and a newly human-ratified run manifest all pass. Failure is terminal for this change's substrate.
edges.rationale: Makes installation semantics and fit a pre-compute rejection gate.

loops.before: No exact CompilerGym v6 wake loop exists.
loops.after: For each available decision: fresh canonical ORIENT packet -> parse-or-charge bounded ContextPlan -> common retrieve -> fresh canonical THINK_ACT packet -> parse-or-charge one INSPECT, TOOL_CALL, ENV_ACT/APPLY_PASS, NOTE_APPEND, FOCUS_REVISE, or STOP -> execute one registered public operation -> append complete sealed public event -> harness charges all logical costs. Each malformed output consumes budget; no hidden retry.
loops.trigger: Every decision in acquisition or sterile target task until STOP, terminal environment state, or frozen decision/call/token/action budget exhaustion.
reads: same mounted treatment LoRA or null adapter
current public CompilerGym observation and legal action projection
loops.stop_condition: Frozen budget exhaustion, STOP, terminal public environment outcome, or declared unrecoverable failure; no provider/session state survives a call.
loops.rationale: One recurrent model has two explicit invocation states, with state carried only by declared authoritative packet channels.

loops.before: v1 left write targets, selection, outcomes, and optimizer persistence open.
loops.after: At frozen task-boundary cadence seal the ledger/notebook prefix, compile authentic outcome-bound ORIENT/ACT/REVISE rows and corresponding manifest, rebuild a cumulative adapter from clean base with a fresh optimizer, atomically publish it only on receipt success, perform HARNESS sham/quarantine, and cold-reset all trainer/inference/cache state. The Stage-C BINDING_SHUFFLED diagnostic starts from the exact authentic selected inputs and typed focus/action target multiset, then deterministically deranges those target objects across compatible public-state strata before rendering; row/view/token/update budgets remain identical or the control fails construction. It tests state-to-useful-operation binding and does not purport to isolate outcome-conditioned selection.
loops.trigger: Only after acquisition tasks 4 and 8 in Stage C; Stage A/B do not open pilot targets and Stage D needs a new ratified manifest.
reads: sealed life-local public ledger and declared notebook
pinned base/tokenizer and immutable preservation anchors
writes: treatment serialized LoRA or HARNESS quarantine bytes
atomic trainer receipt and failure seal
loops.stop_condition: Successful atomic receipt, or a schema/provenance/derangement/numerical/integrity failure that seals the cell failed without repair or retry.
loops.rationale: SLEEP is a deterministic non-cognitive write boundary, not a second agent.

loops.before: v1 mixed checkpoint controls with independently evolving lives.
loops.after: At each sealed checkpoint cold-start authentic and adapter-off target forks; at final checkpoint additionally cold-start binding-shuffled. Run the same capped wake loop and deterministic correctness-gated instruction-count metrics, then quarantine/destroy descendants. No evaluation state is readable by acquisition, retriever, compiler, or later checkpoint.
loops.trigger: Stage C checkpoints 0, 4, and 8 after target panel sealing; all later replication schedules require new ratification.
writes: quarantined target metric and integrity receipts
loops.stop_condition: Target budget/terminal state then mandatory descendant teardown; interrupted cells remain indeterminate and are not regenerated under the same identity.
loops.rationale: Defines condition-specific causal estimands without creating hidden on-policy arms.

claims.before: No v6 CompilerGym claim boundary exists.
claims.after: If later gates pass, the strongest Stage C result is only a one-paired-life, short-horizon, outcome-grounded adapter mechanism observation: authentic treatment checkpoint action improved from its own zero, exceeded adapter-off on objective sealed action, and a valid binding shuffle lost a material predeclared fraction of that gain without reduced schema validity.
claims.evidence_needed: Sealed split; static/offline fit reports; Stage B rejection gates; one-life paired raw ledgers; authentic/off/shuffle cold-load metrics; validity/style/nearest-neighbor diagnostics; and independent review. Practical margin is derived from acquisition-only canary variance and frozen before target opening.

claims.before: Prior v1 left thought-like traces vulnerable to endpoint or writer-authority confusion.
claims.after: Raw private thought, rationale wording, self-report, or similarity to a preferred human theory is forbidden as a correctness label, primary/secondary promotion endpoint, headline evidence, or positive sleep target. Typed focus/hypothesis is provenance/input only unless a separately ratified pre-outcome public intervention rule makes an operational target loss-bearing.
claims.evidence_needed: Static packet/row mask audit and metric audit showing that only declared public operations, official public outcomes, and resource receipts enter endpoints or target masks.

claims.before: The motivating long-life and ordinary-agent comparison could be implied by a short scout.
claims.after: No Stage A-C outcome establishes consciousness, creativity, abstraction, general intelligence, LoRA superiority, baseline saturation, flywheel compounding, post-context growth, or superiority to all external-memory agents. Those require later fresh-task, powered independent lives, post-context checkpoints, predeclared life-clustered slope model, headroom, and expanded strong external-memory controls.
claims.evidence_needed: A separately ratified Stage D preregistration and evidence satisfying its independent replication and comparator requirements.

acceptance_tests.setup: Canonical fixture packets exercise ORIENT every decision, ContextPlan bounds, THINK_ACT one-operation grammar, fresh reconstruction, common retriever caps, and identical calls/tokens under null and mounted adapter.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the declared packet fields reconstruct each call; no scheduler/second model/KV/chat/free-form field is reachable and malformed output is charged once.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The one-model explicit-conscious-state or bounded parity contract.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden public ledgers cover improvement, delayed setup, failure/recovery, invalid calls, hypotheses, ties, replay, and truncation for authentic and binding-shuffled compile manifests.
acceptance_tests.expected: ORIENT/ACT/REVISE targets and masks are exactly frozen; rationale/hypothesis targets are absent; invalid actions gain no credit; fresh-optimizer cumulative rebuild and shuffled derangement are byte-deterministic or fail sealed.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Identified credit assignment, hypothesis restriction, one learned object, or shuffle construction.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise call/task/sleep/life/fork/crash boundaries with explicit file/process/cache/RNG allowlist and base-plus-adapter cold replay.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only declared ledger/notebook and treatment adapter persist within life; only adapter persists across sleep; all task/process/KV/compiler/trainer/cache state resets; cold base+adapter reproduces assigned condition; HARNESS sham remains invisible.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Full-harness parity, adapter attribution, or boundary isolation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Diff model-visible packets and counters across HARNESS/EXPERIENTIAL and authentic/off/shuffled forks on matched public histories.
acceptance_tests.expected: No arm/condition/adapter origin, row count, checkpoint identity, provider latency, cache warmth, retry, training duration, hidden evaluator, future target, or private-thought signal is visible; condition-specific fork permissions match the matrix.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Causal visibility isolation or matched time/budget semantics.

acceptance_tests.setup: Without importing, downloading, installing, running, or modifying upstream bytes, hash already-local official CompilerGym 0.2.5/LLVM10 artifacts and inspect catalog/projection/reward manifests and public-static POJ104 split constructor.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact official bytes and legal action/reward semantics are locally hashable; no patch/fork/network substitution is needed; candidate POJ104 supports 8 acquisition/4 target related-nonduplicate static split with duplicate/neighbor and target-leakage reports, or the substrate is rejected.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The conditional off-the-shelf substrate and related/nonduplicate basis.

acceptance_tests.setup: Only after separate human authorization, use sealed local artifacts in a disposable offline environment to install unchanged 0.2.5 and replay fixed legal/illegal traces twice from clean processes; seal static POJ104 split before any model call.
acceptance_tests.expected: Identical observations/rewards/reset and instruction-count semantics, bounded failure handling, no source mutation, and no hidden-data/model-output/reward involvement in split; any failure rejects CompilerGym for this change.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Official reproducibility, score integrity, or target blindness.

acceptance_tests.setup: Only after separate human hardware authorization and T01-T06, run acquisition-only programs and a tiny synthetic/cached adapter; do not reveal Stage C targets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Pinned model emits valid public pass operations, reward reacts with measurable headroom, masks/mount-off/cold-load work, and no floor/schema/numerical failure occurs; acquisition-only variance freezes the Stage C practical margin.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Whether the pinned recipe/harness is viable enough to open a pilot.

acceptance_tests.setup: After new run-manifest ratification, execute exactly one counterbalanced paired 8-task life with sleeps 4/8 and sealed four-target checkpoint schedule; run only HARNESS and EXPERIENTIAL on policy.
acceptance_tests.expected: Report all raw pairs, instruction-count improvement conditional on validity, checkpoint AUC/final/first-action/best-of-budget/decisions-to-best, resource ledger, and no target feedback to life; no population/slope/baseline-saturation inference.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: A basic complete-organism mechanism signal under two-agent parity.

acceptance_tests.setup: At each Stage C experiential checkpoint cold-load authentic and adapter-off; at final checkpoint cold-load valid binding-shuffled adapter built from same frozen candidate/row/view/token/update budgets.
acceptance_tests.expected: Authentic must improve from checkpoint zero and exceed adapter-off on objective held-out action; shuffle must lose a predeclared material fraction without validity reduction, or the exact recipe stops without repair/tuning on these cells.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Adapter necessity or outcome-to-state/action binding as the mechanism.

acceptance_tests.setup: Audit validity/parse/compile rates, output length, action/pass distribution, fixed unrelated instruction preservation, exact/near IR/code and repeated-edit neighbors, matched-valid-action reward, and all target masks/metrics.
acceptance_tests.expected: A signal explained by schema/style/global domain drift or neighbor reuse is diagnosed as such; no metric or target depends on private thought/rationale or human-theory matching.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: An outcome-learning interpretation or no-private-thought boundary.

acceptance_tests.setup: A later fresh-task proposal supplies at least three paired-life directional scout (then powered confirmation), post-context checkpoints, whole-life uncertainty model, strong declared external-memory controls, same-corpus text/raw LoRA/wrong-life/rank/retention panels, and independent review.
acceptance_tests.expected: No Stage C result automatically opens Stage D; a new hash-bound change/run preregistration, evidence, independent approval, and human authorization are required.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Any attempt to call one life a replication, slope, saturation, flywheel, paper, or general-agent result.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh reviewer verifies exact implementation/run bytes against this proposal and rejects all scope expansion, including download, patching, alternate gym, model/recipe changes, execution, GPU, or claims without their separately bound approvals.
acceptance_tests.expected: Review verdict and human authorization bind exact allowed scope before each material transition.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Post-hoc selection of the science or unauthorized execution/claim escalation.

human_boundary.decision_question: Do you ratify these exact v6 CompilerGym lifetime architecture bytes and the strictly staged scope: CPU/static design and conditional fit only, then separately authorized bounded canary, then one paired non-claim life with sterile forks, with replication and every broader claim deferred?
